messages:
maya: Quick sync: Orpheus9b smoke results in. Need a short GTN recommendation: int8 default vs int4 opt-in routing. Include a minimal flag snippet.

diego: Numbers (50k token sample): p95 int8=118ms, int4=108ms. Unit cost est: int8 $0.0009/token, int4 $0.00057/token.

lina-qa: Quality: longform QA (>512 tokens) EM drops ~6.4pt int8->int4; hallucination +2.1ppt. Short completions (<=64) negligible change.

sam: Recommend default int8 for longform/high-value. Expose int4 opt-in for short low-risk flows. Canary int4 at 5% on targeted slices.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary to eng-dedicated-orpheus 03:00 UTC (2h). Auto-rollback: >2% EM regression on any primary slice or >20% p95 latency increase.

diego: Proto flag snippet: {"routes":[{"id":"short_optin","match":"tokens<=64 && flow=='low_cost'","model":"orpheus9b-int4","sample_rate":0.05},{"id":"default","model":"orpheus9b-int8","sample_rate":0.95}],"fallbacks":[{"from":"orpheus9b-int4","to":"orpheus9b-int8","triggers":["quality_drop","latency_spike"]}]}

maya: Lina will run AB slices overnight: short snippets, multi-turn, longform QA. Sam to draft GTN blurb with expected ~20-35% unit-cost savings for int4 short flows. Diego to open routing PR. I'll monitor canary.

lina-qa: Will post CSV and pivot table; alert if EM drop >2% on any slice.

sam: If longform gap persists, try KV-cache warmstarts and a mixed-precision variant (top/bottom layers int8).

maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
